items.name: spec-compliance
items.note: AC-1..9 each have an end-to-end test against real git; nothing beyond the spec was added.

items.name: error-handling
items.note: exit 3 is the only block; script crash, uv failure and measurement errors WARN and allow; UTF-8 forced on streams.

items.name: security
items.note: no secrets; token is HEAD-bound, 2-minute, removed on every run; residual disclosed in the spec.

items.name: test-quality
items.note: outcome assertions on real commits, positive-output assertions on allow paths, unit tests for token expiry/single winner.

items.name: performance
items.note: one extra uv run per commit; accepted and disclosed.

items.name: naming-structure
items.note: files under 300 lines, names follow the sibling hook/lib pattern.

items.name: affected-boundaries
items.note: token file, staged-manifest read, hook exit code all round-tripped by real git commits in the tests.

items.name: test-hygiene
items.note: no silent skips except an explicit skip when a later lexer reads a shape; tests fail loudly otherwise.
